recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. Future edits to the moved concepts should usually be made in the FHIR Extension Pack unless a later Jira requests core Device narrative, mapping, or migration guidance changes.

additional_context: Device is active in source/fhir.ini, so the Device StructureDefinition and Device introduction are in current build scope. XML parsing of structuredefinition-Device.xml ignores the old commented definitions and found no active id/path for the five old Device elements. The replacement Device extension StructureDefinitions are maintained in the FHIR Extension Pack checkout, and 2024-09-30 OO HCP minutes match the Jira vote and scope. Focused Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The core conformance surface no longer exposes Device.mode, Device.cycle, Device.duration, Device.gateway, or Device.endpoint, and the active Device note names device-operation-mode, device-operation-cycle, device-operation-duration, device-gateway, and device-endpoint.
